title: Delete a user account
summary: Remove a user account and optionally delete their home directory and mail spool.

steps.explain: Delete the user account. The -r flag removes the user's home directory and mail spool.

placeholders.name: USERNAME
placeholders.description: The name of the user to delete

rollback.explain: Re-create the user account and home directory.

placeholders.name: USERNAME
placeholders.description: The name of the user to recreate

warnings: This action permanently deletes the user's home directory and files. Ensure you have backups if needed.
Do not delete the root user.
